release_notes:
Restrict payment methods to one country and require fixed purchase amounts

- Admins can now limit any payment method (like PayPal) to customers billing from one specific country you choose — not just the US as before.
- Admins can require a payment method to only accept purchases in fixed dollar steps, e.g. only $50, $100, $150, and so on.
- Error messages on the Add Credits page are now clearly shown in red and no longer keep reappearing every time you refresh the page.
- Fixed a bug where a valid US address could get wrongly rejected if a customer typed their state's full name (e.g. "New York") instead of the abbreviation ("NY").
